- Nutri uses the same current/supplemental rows for network KPI aggregation and content rankings.

- Some rows expose a publication timestamp, while others only expose Spanish month/year labels in campaign or ad names.

- ✅ Restored the pre-existing guarded dashboard fallback and reverted all other temporary dashboard/API changes.
- ✅ Verified JavaScript/Python syntax and 2 focused Nutri browser tests (2 passed).

## Next Steps
- Regenerate the Nutri HTML report and visually confirm the production account data after refreshing Streamlit.

- dashboard/report_templates/nutri/script.js — filters only content/ranking candidates by report period.

- Published post text/media now beats creative/ad labels.

- Facebook plugin embeds work off `file://`; FB cards reject Instagram iframe sources.

1. Preview-cache schema changes must invalidate every newly required field.
